title: Distributed lock fairness in Redis Redlock

title: gRPC keepalive ping configuration for long-lived streams
body_first_200: Long-lived bidi streams were dropping at NATs after about 5 minutes idle. Enabling client-side keepalive pings every 30s fixed reconnection storms.
